name: lobby-manager-api
excerpt: A REST API for managing game lobbies and users, designed as a extensible template with CRUD endpoints, token-based authentication, and lobby/user management.
description:
A REST API for managing game lobbies and users, built with C# (ASP.NET Core). Includes a demo frontend using React, TypeScript & Node.js.


Features

This API serves as a template for future projects. While some parts are simplified, it includes the following key features:

  • CRUD endpoints for users and lobbies
  • Token-based authentication
  • Lobby creation and user-management
  • Demo frontend for interacting with the API
  • Basic thread-safety for shared data

Endpoints

Users
  • POST /api/user - Create a new user (returns a bearer token)
  • DELETE /api/user - Delete your own user
  • GET /api/user/me - Get your profile
  • GET /api/user - List all users (paginated)
Lobbies
  • GET /api/lobby - List all lobbies (paginated)
  • POST /api/lobby - Create a new lobby
  • GET /api/lobby/{lobbyId} - Get details of a specific lobby
  • DELETE /api/lobby/{lobbyId} - Delete a lobby (owner only)
  • POST /api/lobby/{lobbyId}/members - Join a lobby
  • DELETE /api/lobby/{lobbyId}/members - Leave a lobby
  • DELETE /api/lobby/{lobbyId}/members/{userId} - Remove a user from a lobby
